note: Feature flags (22 §4, §6.5). Read at build time and by client islands. Unknown flags are OFF. Runtime override: env var FLAG_<NAME>=on|off in Cloudflare Pages. Every flag has an owner and a review date so flags don't pile up. V2.5: each flag has a 'launch' value, the value it must have in production at the public launch (D-068, FR-073). validate_feature_matrix.py checks that every shipping feature's flags launch ON, except the beta-only flags noindex_site and beta_banner and the privacy-gated suggest_email.

explore_goal.what: Explore-by tab: What do you want to do?

suggest_edit.what: Suggest an edit button + S36 on every page

suggest_email.what: Optional email field in S36. Keep OFF until the privacy notice is approved (D-027). Stays off at launch until D-027 approves the privacy notice.

beta_banner.what: Site-wide early-version banner linking to Suggest an edit

admin_report.what: A01 internal admin report (moved from R1.5 into R1 by D-068)

noindex_site.what: Private beta: whole site noindex + robots disallow. Turn OFF per journey at open beta.

helpers.what: Helpers: S39 index, S40 helper page (D-066)

helper_panel.what: S41 Helper panel shown on every page while a helper is active

helper_for_someone.what: Start a helper for someone else; share link and card (FR-072). Turn on once the card text is reviewed.
